Spinners

A turning ring, 1 em across in the color of the text around it, for something small that is on its way. A button shows its own while busy; a region shows an overlay.

Examples

The words beside the spinner say what is happening; the ring alone is hidden from assistive technology.

Rebuilding 3 pages… Larger, in the accent 
<span class="hstack gap-8"><span class="spinner-border" aria-hidden="true"></span>Rebuilding 3 pages…</span>
<span class="hstack gap-8 text-primary fs-20"><span class="spinner-border" aria-hidden="true"></span>Larger, in the accent</span>

Accessibility

  • A spinner turns even for people who ask for less motion — it is the sign that something is happening — and stays a ring in forced colors.
  • Say the same in words, in a live region when it starts after an action.

Tokens

From css/components/spinner.css, which declares no custom property of its own.
